title: GrowthPlan
description: Growth Planner output (ADR-003): LLM ranks WITHIN the code-computed frontier. Selecting a non-frontier topic is a hard failure. Rationale feeds the Parent Coach and Decision Trace.

frontier_snapshot.description: Topic ids whose prerequisites are satisfied and not yet mastered, computed by code at plan time.

selected_topic_id.description: MUST be a member of frontier_snapshot — code-verified.

rationale.description: Selection reasoning: interests, capability priorities, recent evidence.
